title: Component Tiers
description: Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

puzzle.goal: A structure is a chain of N parts and fails as soon as its weakest part fails. Part j carries stress σj; below a threshold stress σu nothing ever breaks, and above it the probability of surviving falls off as a stretched exponential with scale σ0 and modulus m. Write the survival probability of the whole structure.
puzzle.name: Weakest-link (three-parameter Weibull) survival
puzzle.form: prod ( j , 1 , N , exp ( - ( ( σ _ j - σ _ u ) / σ _ 0 ) ^ m ) )
puzzle.ask: If every part carries the same stress the product becomes exp(−N((σ − σu)/σ0)^m). Find P for N = @{N}, σ = @{s} σ0, σu = @{u} σ0, m = 3.

vars.\u03c3: stress (σ_j on part j, σ_u threshold, σ_0 scale)

puzzle.method: The structure survives only if every part does, so multiply the independent part survival probabilities.
